additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380724-DC/Si-D/BE-[Gp2ivN]- Outlet 2 Out of Order CRM:00645000782
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
Please plan a site intervention to check the following connections and carry a spare KF11 and CCS liquid-cooled cable (whichever applicable).
Refer to the image below.
Check the terminal XD16 connections, specifically CAN connections 13 and 14.
Check the connection on XF10 at XD10 I3.
Check the connection on XF11 at CAN 1L and 1H.
If these connections are fine, try replacing the KF11.
If the issue persists, reinstall the original XF11 and replace the cable.
If you have any further questions, please let us know.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
